introduction: DC Health Care Alliance is locally funded medical assistance for qualifying residents outside Medicaid. Current adult eligibility differs from older descriptions.
description: DC Health Care Alliance is locally funded medical assistance for qualifying residents outside Medicaid. Current adult eligibility differs from older descriptions.

sections.who: DHCF’s current adult page lists ages 21–25, District residency, financial eligibility and no other health insurance, including Medicare. Children use a separate Alliance pathway.
sections.get: The current adult page describes fee-for-service care rather than managed-care delivery. Confirm a participating provider before an appointment.
sections.docs:
• Age, District address and household income information.
  • Details of any existing insurance.
  • Records requested by the eligibility office.
sections.apply:
1. Check the correct pathway

    Review DHCF’s adult Alliance page and the separate children’s link.

  2. Ask about current intake

    Use DHCF’s linked application guidance or contact DHS at 202-727-5355 to identify the correct application.

  3. Read the decision and provider guidance

    Do not rely on a previous managed-care card or an older guide to determine current coverage.
sections.after: Keep renewal and coverage-change notices. Ask DHCF about other coverage or care options if the current Alliance category does not fit.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Current DHCF adult Alliance eligibility. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
